plan.title: PR-PR-028 Reassign Line Item Plan Availability

steps.note: Navigate to the Purchase Requisitions area where the PR line-item reassignment capability would be exercised.

args.need: sign in as the Procurement Manager on a tenant below the Growth plan and on a Growth tenant, then try Reassign Line Item on the same PR line item and verify it is absent or refused below Growth but available and successful on Growth

steps.note: The catalog has no plan-tier switching or Reassign Line Item action, and the comparison requires separate tenant contexts.
Assert that the session remains free of application errors after the tester's comparison.
